business:
CREATE TABLE `business` (
  `id_business` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `legal_name` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `address` varchar(1000) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `logo_url` varchar(1000) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `plan` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `created_by` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_by` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `subscription_status` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'trial',
  `trial_starts_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `trial_ends_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_period_starts_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_period_ends_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `suspended_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancelled_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `status_reason` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_business`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ux_business_slug` (`slug`),
  KEY `idx_business_subscription_status` (`subscription_status`),
  KEY `idx_business_trial_ends_at` (`trial_ends_at`),
  KEY `idx_business_active` (`active`),
  KEY `idx_business_plan` (`plan`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

login:

session:

refresh_token:
CREATE TABLE `refresh_token` (
  `id_refresh_token` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `id_login` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `id_session` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_hash` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_fingerprint` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `family_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `parent_token_hash` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `issued_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `rotated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `revoked_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `revoked_reason` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `reused_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `last` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_by` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_ip` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_user_agent` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id_refresh_token`),
  KEY `idx_refresh_token_hash` (`token_hash`),
  KEY `idx_refresh_token_login` (`id_login`),
  KEY `idx_refresh_token_session` (`id_session`),
  KEY `idx_refresh_token_family` (`family_id`),
  KEY `idx_refresh_token_expires` (`expires_at`),
  KEY `idx_refresh_token_active_lookup` (`id_login`,`id_session`,`last`,`revoked_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci AVG_ROW_LENGTH=16384;
